## The bull case

Guidance of 940 to 980 USD millions implies about 11 percent growth at the midpoint, and management repeated the range in July. Repeating a range mid-year is what a business on plan does.

- Free cash flow of 121.3 USD millions funds the growth plan without new debt.
- The market value of roughly 9.7 USD billions still prices the company as a regional player, not the category leader it is becoming.

The rating is full, but full ratings persist while delivery continues. **The burden of proof sits with the bears** until a guided quarter is missed.
